Bailed at t=6m when price broke to a NEW worse extreme (-22.25, deeper than the prior -15 trough) with the new adverse leg showing 64pt amplitude and only 8pct giveback -- i.e. sustained pressure against the position rather than a bounce. Next time I'd watch for the 'lower low' signature specifically (adverse excursion exceeding the prior trough) as the tell that a dip has become a genuine reversal, rather than reacting to the first red print or a single multi-signal-against reading that gets partially reclaimed.
